clips.title: The story
paras: After tracking down Catelyn the Blade on behalf of her father, an adventurer learns that her weapon is no longer in her hands. She demands that her lost dagger be retrieved from a pirate named Pretty Boy Duncan before she cooperates further.

Following the trail from Ansirem's Key leads directly to Catelyn the Blade, who ran away from a quiet life of scholarship and dusty tomes alongside mages. She cannot hand over her dagger at her father's request, since she no longer has it. If anyone hopes to secure her blade, they will first have to deal with the Bloodsail Buccaneer who took it.

Catelyn suffered an uncharacteristic defeat at the hands of Pretty Boy Duncan, who struck her unconscious and made off with her signature weapon. As a fighter who relies on her personal knife, she insists on recovering that exact weapon from the buccaneer before anything else can move forward.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My FATHER sent you? I'd have thought that old codger would have given up on me by now.
It wasn't really his fault I ran off, he just shouldn't have expected I'd be willing to live a boring life, reading over musty books and associating with grey-haired, stiff-backed, stuffy mages!
If you need my dagger, you'll have to get it back from "Pretty Boy" Duncan, one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Put something 'tween his shoulders and I'm sure he'll give it up.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'd never been beat before, you know, friend? Sure I'd been cut, can't get in a knife fight without that, but he just smacked me on the side of the head, blacked me out. When I came to my blade was gone.
As much as my nickname might indicate, I still need a knife to fight, and for me, it has to be that one.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You beat Duncan? I guess you aren't as wet behind the ears as you looked at first glance.
I suppose that also means I shouldn't challenge you to a fight any time soon!
